description:
FILED s543f (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-21), PPI batch 11 member 1 (§11 / §71).

    $_ = "x"; print STDOUT /x/, "\n";
      perl: 1            PCL: statement dropped ("Handle single node of unknown type")

After PCL's PPI group BE (§71) a `/` after a BUILTIN that takes an operand is a match on the branch, but a bareword FILEHANDLE after print is a user's word to PPI (`STDOUT` is not a keyword), so the `/` stays an Operator -- the user half of §11, which `Pl::Parser2::_repair_word_match` owns.  The repair declines because it asks `_word_is_term`, whose ALL-CAPS guess reads `STDOUT` as a constant.  `_repair_word_x_call` already has the fix shape for the sibling `print STDOUT x()`: it asks `_word_is_declared_term` (no ALL-CAPS guess), because after a print-family keyword an undeclared ALL-CAPS word is a handle, not an operand.  The same predicate split applies here, keyed on the word after print / printf / say (not every ALL-CAPS word: `FOO / 2` with an imported constant must keep dividing).

Same on main ffc7eb72 (base drops too).  Probe: scratch/s543f/p1/s28.pl in the s543f worktree.
BAR: `print STDOUT /x/`, `print STDERR /x/ ? 1 : 0`, `printf STDOUT /x/ ? "y" : "n"` vs perl; controls `use constant FOO => 4; print FOO / 2`, `print STDOUT 4 / 2`; corpus-diff + the wide A/B; a guard row beside #872's.
subject: LOUD: print STDOUT /x/ drops the statement -- the user half of PPI section 11 (_repair_word_match's ALL-CAPS guess reads the handle as a constant)
triage_reason: a whole-statement drop of print to a bareword handle with a match operand (IN: print, regex)
